# Our Hypotheses Carry Supernumerary Features That Clash

If I could restrict my notion of the Absolute to its bare holiday-giving value, it wouldn't clash with my other truths.[^1] But we cannot easily thus restrict our hypotheses.[^2] They carry supernumerary features, and these it is that clash so.[^3] My disbelief in the Absolute means then disbelief in those other supernumerary features, for I fully believe in the legitimacy of taking moral holidays.[^4]

[^1]: [[Pragmatism - Lecture II - What Pragmatism Means#The True Is the Good in the Way of Belief]] "If I could restrict my notion of the Absolute to its bare holiday-giving value, it wouldn't clash with my other truths."
[^2]: [[Pragmatism - Lecture II - What Pragmatism Means#The True Is the Good in the Way of Belief]] "But we cannot easily thus restrict our hypotheses."
[^3]: [[Pragmatism - Lecture II - What Pragmatism Means#The True Is the Good in the Way of Belief]] "They carry supernumerary features, and these it is that clash so."
[^4]: [[Pragmatism - Lecture II - What Pragmatism Means#The True Is the Good in the Way of Belief]] "My disbelief in the Absolute means then disbelief in those other supernumerary features, for I fully believe in the legitimacy of taking moral holidays."
